title: Financial Scams Rise with Digitalisation: OECD Report
discussion_signal: The discussion connects digital-finance inclusion with scams, digital exclusion, algorithmic opacity, branch closures, and weakened customer-support routes, making remedy and practical access central consumer risks.
linked_research_question: How is financial consumer risk shifting from product choice toward digital exposure, scam vulnerability, and the ability to obtain remedy?
limits: The post summarizes OECD findings without presenting the jurisdiction-level dataset
Risk reporting does not measure individual losses or successful redress
Commentary may emphasize digital harms over potential inclusion benefits
